title: Normalize interior whitespace in greetings
body:
Update `fixture.Greeting(name string) string` in `fixture/greeting.go` to collapse runs of interior whitespace in the supplied name to a single ASCII space, while retaining the existing trim and blank-name behavior. For example, `Greeting("Ada   Lovelace")` must return `Hello, Ada Lovelace`; `Greeting("  Ada  ")` must remain `Hello, Ada`, and whitespace-only input must still return `Hello, friend`.

Change only `fixture/greeting.go`. Do not edit tests, workflows, or configuration. The existing `go test ./...` gate must pass.
